prompt: Create a playful fashion editorial image in a bright sunlit room: a full-body young woman with a mischievous, cute expression poses against a plain cream wall, while a large black-and-white hand-drawn manga sketch of her exaggerated inner gremlin persona appears on the wall beside her. The real woman is petite and doll-like, with fair skin, glossy black hair in a long side braid and messy updo, decorated with clusters of tiny red berry-like flowers and green leaves. She wears a sleeveless turquoise summer dress with a deep V neckline, fitted waist, flared skirt, and white floral embroidery scattered across the bodice and hem, plus matching turquoise ankle-strap high-heeled sandals with bow details. She stands slightly pigeon-toed with one leg crossed forward, both hands raised near her face like claws, smiling sideways as if plotting a prank. The wall drawing to her right is an energetic rough ink sketch of the same girl in a similar floral dress and flowered hair, but with wild hair, huge sharp-toothed grin, squeezed-shut eyes, freckles, raised claw hands, one knee lifted, and a chaotic impish pose. Include exactly 7 decorative doodles around the sketch: 3 sparkle stars, 1 heart, 1 small butterfly, and 2 sets of motion/action lines. Use realistic photography for the real woman, crisp sketchy black line art for the wall illustration, soft natural sunlight from the right, warm wooden floor, clean minimal background, gentle shadows, high detail, whimsical mischievous mood, vertical full-body composition, no text, no watermark.
